facts.business: Next MediaWorks Limited operates the private FM radio brand 'Radio One' and is a subsidiary of HT Media Ltd.

auditor.name: S R Batliboi & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The financial statements have been prepared on a basis that the Company is not a going concern.

key_risks: Radio segment underperformed due to subdued advertiser sentiment and pressure on advertising rates
Growth uncertainty driven by profitability challenges and shifting audience tastes
Negative networth and not a going concern
Macroeconomic shifts and evolving global conflicts
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were in ordinary course of business and on arms' length terms. No contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were entered into during the year under review.
